bugClass.title: Packaged app identity and bundle permissions are incorrect
bugClass.cause: The packager does not align the executable identity and bundle file permissions with runtime assumptions. Packaged-only startup logic can be skipped when the app reports itself as unpackaged, and shipped files can retain world-writable permissions. No assembled-app launch catches these packaging failures.
bugClass.criteria: Classify another site when its packaging configuration or build output can preserve an unexpected executable/app identity that makes packaged-runtime checks false, independently of whether startup code gated on that check is skipped; or when packaged files are emitted with world-writable permissions. These are independent qualifying paths. Relevant evidence includes packaged-only startup gates and the actual packaged artifact configuration or permissions.
